text:
maya (PM): Customer Z asked for a private pilot with tenant SLAs, per-tenant model pinning, and HSM-backed keys. Target launch in 3 weeks. We need cross-team alignment on must-haves vs nice-to-haves.

ajay (runtime): Key runtime work: tenant pinning, KV namespace isolation, and cold-start mitigation. Cold-start is the riskiest for p95 latency.

leah (infra): Cold-start mitigation needs either reserved prewarm slots or a fast shared prewarm pool. Reserving impacts other pilots; need QPS estimates.

priya (security): HSM/KMS intake will need artifacts: SOC report, key rotation policy, threat model. Legal will likely insist on written confirmation if we postpone HSM. Compliance review ~2 weeks.

samir (platform): If we do envelope encryption with managed KMS for Phase 1, we can shave about a week. But customer explicitly requested HSM.

maya (PM): Proposed split: Phase 1 = isolation, pinning, managed KMS, small prewarm pool; Phase 2 = full HSM + audit + key rotation. Can infra/runtime agree?

ajay (runtime): Phase 1 OK if prewarm pool available and we accept limited concurrency. Phase 2 needs async key caching and runtime HSM latency handling (+2w).

leah (infra): I can tentatively allocate 2-GPU prewarm pool for Phase 1 pending customer QPS. Ops calendar is tight next week; need sign-off today.

priya (security): For Phase 1 we'll provide an elevated audit trail. Legal will need signed consent from the customer acknowledging phased HSM delivery. I'll start the HSM intake now.

samir (platform): Risk list: 1) customer refuses phased approach, 2) prewarm affects other pilots, 3) missing KMS artifacts hold launch.

maya (PM): Actions: 1) I'll ask customer for written agreement to phased pilot by EOD. 2) @leah please tentatively reserve 2 GPUs. 3) @ajay open a feature-flagged PR for tenant pinning + prewarm toggle. 4) @priya start KMS/HSM intake and list legal artifacts.

ajay (runtime): Opening WIP PR now. Feature flags snippet in PR: feature_flags: tenant_pin=true, prewarm_hook=on, prewarm.pool=2. Also adding a smoke job for warm/cold.

leah (infra): Pool reserved tentatively and ops blocker posted. If burst >200 RPS we need to revisit.

priya (security): Intake started. I requested SOC, rotation policy, threat model. ETA: checklist in 48h. Looping legal.

samir (platform): I'll add a lower-cost model fallback to keep user latency bounded if pool saturates. Need to surface degraded quality to customer.

maya (PM): Draft acceptance criteria: 1) Prewarm pool provisioned and validated (2 GPUs) 2) Tenant pinning + KV isolation feature flagged and smoke-tested 3) First-token p95 < 500ms for <=200 RPS baseline 4) Security checklist acknowledged by legal 5) Customer signed phased consent.

ajay (runtime): Smoke tests + perf collector added. Linking PR -> smoke job.

leah (infra): Staging smoke: warm flow OK, cold p95 ~700ms. Above gate.

ajay (runtime): I'll tweak prewarm hook to keep 1 worker per GPU warm; should cut ~150ms. Pushing in 15m.

leah (infra): If tweak doesn't meet <500ms we'll need pool=3 (ops approval).

maya (PM): If pool expands, I'll get customer signoff and update cost estimate. Keep updates here.

ops-bot: deploy request created by ajay  id=deploy-4421 status=pending

leah (infra): Post-tweak smoke: cold p95 ~480ms. Passing gate for baseline traffic.

ajay (runtime): Great. I'll merge feature-flagged PR and keep toggle for rollback.

priya (security): Legal asked customer for written acceptance of phased delivery. Also uploaded the intake checklist.

maya (PM): Thanks team. If legal or customer blocks HSM deferral, we reconvene to decide scope or timeline. Aim for soft pilot Mon if all gates hold. :rocket:
